title: The Importance of Quality for Scaling Up Early Childhood Development Services: Experimental Evidence from Nicaragua
abstract: This study evaluates a national home-visiting early-childhood development program in Nicaragua, asking how its effects change when delivery quality is monitored during scale-up. Experimental evidence shows improvements in children’s development and preschool completion, alongside changes in parenting practices. The findings indicate that expansion can preserve benefits when service quality is actively supported and tracked, including through community-based monitoring.
